QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Gate to the Future
QuestInfo.0: Go to the Temple Keeper at the Temple of Time, and find out all you can about the rumor. What exactly is happening there?
QuestInfo.1:
Calm the Temple Keeper down with an All Cure Potion and ask about the rumor.


#i2050004##t2050004# #b#c2050004# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: The Temple Keeper explained the rumor in detail. Underlings of the Black Mage had indeed attacked the temple.

0.0: (Shaking his head) What is it? My mind is so fuzzy... It's hard to breathe. You're... here to verify the rumor?

yes.0: I see. I've been feeling so ill since the incident...\r\nPlease, bring me #b1 All Cure Potion#k, and I'll explain everything.

1.0: It's the All Cure Potion, thank you. I'm sure I'll feel better now.

yes.0: The Black Mage sent his underlings to attack this place. They were after the altar.
yes.1: Luckily, I was able to repel them. However, a crack has formed on the Gate to the Future.

item.0: Ugh... I feel faint. I need an #bAll Cure Potion#k. You can buy one, if you don't have any to spare...
